Title: FMusicTransitionOverride
Overview: MusicTransitionOverrides contain the data that define how a MusicLayout horizontally transitions between MusicSegments in one-off scenarios. They are only used when using the QueueMusicTransitionOverride() function on a MusicLayout, which ignores the transition rules and only uses the MusicTransitionOverride. NOTE: The word "music" in this context refers to the sound asset reference held by a MusicSegment.
